author: Cezbla
body:
Hello guys as the title says I think you should be prestige if your going to apply for mod, 

you probably disagree but, it shows lack in time that you were on, even if the mod or manager or director isn't a donor they should still have to take the time to get prestige 1 at least, if not no offense to anyone it shows lack in time play and they aren't respected that much to be honest, compare jozz to sweetmango or another one, jozz is more known and respected not saying he is better I am being honest, sweetmango is a amazing Jr.Mod and I want him for mod, but he isn't as well known as jozz and isn't as respected I have seen many people swear at him behind his back. But not once once swearing at jozz,

staff you wont understand but other players when you see a prestige 5 mod it kinda makes their impression better.

its like meeting justin beiber more titles then most a really famous person very good [I hate him though but its a good example], but then you meet micheal jackson [if he was alive] more titles famous famous the top of the world

which would you respect more? 



best regards, PS I am not trying to be rude here :) 


 Thank you


Cezbla

replies.body: This is unnecessary because you may respect a player with prestige 5 more but someone like sweet mango dedicates his/her time to help the community instead of kill farming for xp. I get your point about online time but there is already a minimum time, also the_detonator_ is manager and only prestige 1 in neb. He does his manager job very well.
